projectDescription: An AutoHotkey v2 macro that automatically uses the Biome Randomizer and Strange Controller items on cooldown in the Roblox game Sol's RNG, with AFK prevention, Windows OCR-based item detection, and optional Discord webhook notifications.
keyFeatures: Automatic Biome Randomizer usage on a configurable cooldown (default 35.2 minutes)
Automatic Strange Controller usage on a configurable cooldown (default 20.2 minutes)
Windows OCR-based inventory item detection with fuzzy matching
AFK prevention via periodic Space/E/F keypresses and mouse clicks
Eden detection via OCR with automatic merchant dialogue handling
Discord webhook notifications with screenshot upload via Catbox
Heavenly Potion auto-crafting support with configurable ingredient amounts
Window targeting by HWND or title, with Ctrl+Click picker
Persistent settings saved to settings.ini on exit
Available as both an AHK script and a compiled EXE
publicApiSurface: Toggle Active button — starts/stops the automation scheduler
Force Biome Use button — immediately uses the Biome Randomizer
Force Strange Use button — immediately uses the Strange Controller
Force AFK button — immediately performs the AFK action
Toggle Biome Use button — enables/disables Biome Randomizer automation
Toggle Strange Use button — enables/disables Strange Controller automation
Ctrl+Click = active window button — sets the target window by clicking on it
Apply text as HWND/title button — sets the target window from the text field
